subject.title: fix(browser): keep guarded CDP sockets on validated endpoints [AI]

question: Should guarded `existing-session` Browser profiles with an explicit `cdpUrl` fail closed until Chrome MCP can accept an OpenClaw-pinned transport?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes an existing attachment path to avoid an unpinned subprocess boundary; that security-versus-compatibility policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept fail-closed Chrome MCP behavior
options.body: Approve the documented migration to the regular `openclaw` driver for guarded remote CDP endpoints after final-head proof is posted.

options.title: Preserve Chrome MCP compatibility
options.body: Require an owner-reviewed transport or relay design that carries the approved endpoint through the Chrome MCP subprocess boundary before merging.

options.title: Split the scope
options.body: Separate guarded upload behavior from the CDP transport hardening so its compatibility effects can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed Chrome MCP behavior
recommendation.body: Approve the documented migration to the regular `openclaw` driver for guarded remote CDP endpoints after final-head proof is posted.
